name: Refugee Status Determination (UNHCR)

qualifying_event.description: Egypt has no domestic asylum law or refugee-status-determination body; UNHCR conducts registration and refugee status determination directly under a memorandum of understanding with the Egyptian government.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Registration with UNHCR Egypt; identity documentation; RSD interview.

requirements.blocker_text: UNHCR (not the Egyptian government) determines whether the applicant meets the international refugee definition, via registration and one or more RSD interviews.
Applicants must provide genuine identity documentation where possible, and truthful, complete information throughout the process.

evidence_required.document: Consistent, truthful testimony across RSD interviews

outcome.duration_length: Refugee card upon recognition; 30-day appeal window on denial

sources.title: UNHCR Egypt -- Refugee Status Determination (RSD): UNHCR (not the Egyptian government) decides, registration/interview process, right to an interpreter and legal representation, confidentiality, refugee card on recognition, 30-day appeal window

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Egypt). STATUS: DRAFT -- same structural pattern as several Caribbean states built earlier this session (e.g. Saint Lucia, Grenada, Saint Vincent): Egypt is not itself the decision-maker, UNHCR is, operating under a longstanding memorandum of understanding rather than Egypt's own domestic asylum legislation. work_rights modeled 'none' and study_rights modeled 'restricted' as conservative placeholders: the source does not explicitly address either during processing, and Egypt's Labour Law framework (see eg_work_permit.json's 10:1 Egyptianization ratio) makes it unlikely asylum seekers have unrestricted access to formal employment while a claim is pending -- flagged as an inference, not a stated fact. leads_to_citizenship modeled false: no route from recognized-refugee status to Egyptian naturalization was found stated in this pass; a recognized refugee would presumably need to pursue eg_naturalisation.json's standard 10-year route like any other resident, though this was not explicitly confirmed for refugees specifically.
